title: FuelTech Boost Controller & Dashboard
tag_line: FuelTech-inspired boost controller with Auto Max safety, 12x12 grid HUD, interactive boost maps, power curves, and telemetry.
message:
FuelTech Boost Controller & Dashboard

A boost-by-RPM controller and full-screen racing HUD inspired by FuelTech standalone ECUs.

Features:
- Boost-by-RPM table with 6 configurable breakpoints and linear interpolation
- AUTO MAX preset — automatically calculates maximum safe boost per RPM to stay under engine torque limit
- MIN / MAX / CUSTOM presets for quick tuning
- Interactive boost map — drag breakpoints to tune in real-time
- Power/Torque graph showing projected vs stock curves (HP & Nm)
- Engine torque limit indicator with danger zone highlighting
- 12x12 responsive grid layout
- Circular RPM and Boost gauges (right side)
- Mini gauges for Oil Temp, Water Temp, Throttle, Turbo RPM
- Digital Speed and Gear display (bottom right)
- Toggle to show/hide graphs, mini gauges, and buttons for a clean view
- Transparent HUD overlay — see the game through the dashboard
- Peak boost tracking with overboost warning
- Works with any turbocharged vehicle

Installation:
1. Place in mods/unpacked/ or zip and place in mods/
2. Launch game, load any turbocharged vehicle
3. Open vehicle config, select FuelTech Boost Controller under Additional Modification
4. Open the FuelTech Dashboard app via the UI apps menu
5. Select a preset or drag boost map points to tune

Controls:
- MIN: Conservative low boost
- MAX: Maximum boost (no safety limit)
- AUTO MAX: Calculates max safe boost per RPM (stays under engine torque limit)
- CUSTOM: Drag breakpoints on the boost map to custom tune
- Click PK to reset peak boost
- Click SHOW/HIDE GRAPHS to toggle graph visibility
